title: [Origin] Rush
description: A glass cannon with an aggressive play style
body:
# Generel Information
A glass cannon with an aggressive playing style.

This origin requires **Origins** and **Pehkui** to work properly.

## Rush
Fueled by fear and anger, these humans will fight beyond death itself, to slaughter those who stand in their way.

### 🟡Adrenaline
Above your hunger bar is a bar showing your Adrenaline.
Adrenaline builds up when taking damage or attacking something and drains slowly when outside of combat.
Adrenaline makes you stronger and faster, but also more vulnerable.

### 🟢Overdrive
Reaching maximum Adrenaline triggers Overdrive, increasing speed and strength further. Adrenaline will drain steadily and cannot be regained in this state.

### 🔴Fatigue
When Adrenaline reaches zero during Overdrive, or on respawn, you enter Fatigue, becoming weaker, slower, and disoriented.

### 🟢Last Resort
Dying during Overdrive triggers Last Resort, restoring Adrenaline to its maximum and preventing death until it drains completely.
If it reaches 0, you will inevitably die.

### 🔴Unwieldy
Your fighting style prevents the use of shields and ranged weapons.
Furthermore, armor is practically useless to you.

### 🔵Parry
Parry an attack, negating between 20% and 80% of the damage depending on your timing.
